defaultItem.title: Ignite: The Remembering
defaultItem.subtitle: 3-month 1:1 container
defaultItem.text:
You gave everything to everyone — except yourself.
And somewhere along the way, your dreams got forgotten — for everyone else's.

Ignite is where that ends.

This is a 3-month 1:1 container built around you — your story, your dreams, your voice. We start by getting to know her — the woman underneath all the roles, all the giving, all the noise. Then we unpack everything that's been keeping her quiet.

By the time we're done, you will know who you are. You will trust your own voice. And you will be taking real steps toward a life that is undeniably, unapologetically yours.

Not a life that almost fits.
A life you claim with pride and love — the magical life you always dreamed of.
